title: New US Food Advice Not to Everyone’s Taste
main_content:
Americans can eat eggs without feeling guilty, according to new nutritional guidelines issued by the U.S. government.

A person can eat as many eggs as they like each day, the updated guidelines say. One large chicken egg has about 186 milligrams of cholesterol.

Older guidelines restricted cholesterol intake to 300 milligrams a day. Two eggs would be more than the daily limit.

The guidelines were issued by the U.S. Department of Agriculture and the Department of Health and Human Services.

The government guidelines are issued every five years. It is designed to help set nutritional standards.

Other tips to stay healthy included advice to limit intake of sugars to 10 percent. Saturated fat calories found in red meat, butter, cheese, milk and ice cream should be limited each day to 10 percent.

The guidelines promoted eating more fruits, vegetables and nuts.

Some are critical of the new guidelines.
